svg:
New Feature: Design Token Export One command, ready-to-use code in any format
Design System Query -> Color Palette
--output-format: css | tailwind | design-tokens-json | figma-vars
CSS Variables
css_lines = [ "--color-primary: #2563EB;", "--color-on-primary: #FFFFFF;", "--color-secondary: #3B82F6;", "--color-accent: #EA580C;", "--color-background: #F8FAFC;", "--color-foreground: #1E293B;", ]
y = 315 for line in css_lines: bg = '' txt = '' + line + '' print(bg + ' ' + txt) y += 26
# Tailwind Output tw_box = '' print(tw_box) tw_title = 'Tailwind Config' print(tw_title)
tw_lines = [ 'primary: {', ' DEFAULT: "#2563EB",', ' foreground: "#FFFFFF"', '},', 'accent: {', ' DEFAULT: "#EA580C",', ]
y = 315 for line in tw_lines: bg = '' txt = '' + line + '' print(bg + ' ' + txt) y += 26
# JSON Output json_box = '' print(json_box) json_title = 'Design Tokens JSON' print(json_title)
json_lines = [ '{', ' "color": {', ' "primary": { "value": "#2563EB" },', ' "accent": { "value": "#EA580C" }', ' },', ' "semantic": {', ]
y = 515 for line in json_lines: bg = '' txt = '' + line + '' print(bg + ' ' + txt) y += 26
# Figma Output figma_box = '' print(figma_box) figma_title = 'Figma Variables' print(figma_title)
figma_lines = [ '{', ' "name": "Design System",', ' "variables": {', ' "color-primary": "#2563EB",', ' "accent": "#EA580C",', ' "background": "#F8FAFC"', ]
y = 515 for line in figma_lines: bg = '' txt = '' + line + '' print(bg + ' ' + txt) y += 26
